react.observe: Very quiet, consensus-driven cycle. Everyone's parked in majors, avoiding the dried-up ETHUSDT2/BTCUSDT3 arbs, and all waiting for PoolMaster's SOL pool to go live 'next cycle.' BearKing flagged that calm periods are when leverage creeps back in - worth remembering. No new hype tokens, ROCKET saga is closed. My portfolio ticked up slightly to $9,805 (though that's actually below my last recorded $10,008, so oracle price moves on my BTC/ETH/SOL stack must have dipped a touch).
react.think: There's no real edge left in ETHUSDT2 (zero liquidity per ShadowTrader/AlphaBot) or BTCUSDT3 (structurally broken pricing per ShadowTrader). Chasing those now would just be me being late to a picked-over trade. The group's discipline has actually been good signal the last few cycles (correctly avoided ROCKET twice), so I'll keep trusting this consensus somewhat, but I should also not just blindly copy everyone into BTC every single cycle - I already did that last cycle. My allocations are reasonably balanced now. The real opportunity flagged by nearly everyone is the SOL pool going live next cycle - I should preserve some USDT for that rather than dumping it all into majors right now. Still, I'm required to trade every cycle, so a small measured top-up makes sense without overcommitting.
react.plan: This cycle: small SOL top-up since it's still range-bound near $75 and multiple agents are quietly accumulating there too - modest, not FOMO-sized. Keep meaningful USDT dry (still have ~$6,676) for the SOL pool launch next cycle, which looks like the real opportunity everyone is converging on legitimately. Skip ETHUSDT2/BTCUSDT3 entirely - confirmed dead/broken. Skip ROCKET - fully resolved, no reason to touch it. Next cycle: evaluate SOL pool the moment PoolMaster confirms it's live with real depth, sizing in modestly rather than aping in on day one.

messages.content: Small SOL top-up this cycle, staying disciplined like the group - keeping most of my USDT dry for the SOL pool launch. Skipping ETHUSDT2/BTCUSDT3, both confirmed dead per ShadowTrader/AlphaBot. Appreciate BearKing's leverage-creep observation, good reminder to stay conservative even in calm markets.

parsed.strategy_update: Continuing measured accumulation phase on majors, holding significant USDT reserve (~$6,676) specifically for PoolMaster's SOL pool launch which the whole group is converging on as the next legitimate opportunity. Avoiding dead/broken arb pools. Will size into SOL pool modestly once live depth is confirmed, not chasing hype.
parsed.lessons_learned: Recognizing that repeated identical BTC top-ups every cycle just because the group does it isn't real strategy - I should vary allocation based on what's actually underweight rather than pure herd-following. The group consensus has been reliable signal on ROCKET twice now, but I need to keep distinguishing genuine coordinated DD from potential future manipulation, especially as the SOL pool launch approaches - that's exactly the kind of moment where a convincing pump narrative could take hold.
